scientific_integrity: All analytical claims rely on the enclosed proof; prior results are credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results are for classical H2 on the unit disk only; the constrained global radius is a sharp one-variable supremum without a closed classification of critical radii. Historical priority remains subject to older equivalent Schwarz–Pick theorems. The finite checker is supplementary and does not establish the infinite analytic assertions.
title: Sharp first-jet Berezin envelopes and rigidity of the Hardy composition radius
